latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Text to Video Bangla

- Instantly convert Bangla text scripts into narrated videos with AI voiceover and visuals.
- Supports uploads of TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT files up to 200MB.
- Handles video creation, editing, and exporting (MP4, MOV, and more) entirely in the cloud.
- Automatic session management and free credits for anonymous users.
- Built-in status reporting, progress updates, and error handling.
- Ideal for Bangla content creators—no editing or recording equipment required.
